Name: Season Match
Description: The league. Ninety minutes against another side, three Stars rotating at STAR PLAYER SWITCH, and the result goes in the table.

Name: Friendly
Description: PLAY A MATCH from the base. Not a fixture - a side put together on the spot at roughly your own level. Opponent = scratch is what does that; see scratch_team.gd and team_level.gd. You still collect, from the two Rewards columns.

Name: Test Match
Description: ROUND AN - THE MATCH MAKER's Test Match (data/MatchMaker.csv; Anthony: matches are counted in cycles). Two Play Maker cycles, 30 minutes on the clock for each (60), so one Star swap at STAR PLAYER SWITCH. The Play Makers fit the shorter clock by themselves (main_scene.gd). Pays a little less than a Normal Match.

Name: Quick Match
Description: ROUND AN - THE MATCH MAKER's Quick Match (data/MatchMaker.csv). One Play Maker cycle: three rounds, one Star, 30 minutes on the clock. Not the old `quick` row above, which has no clock and is not on the Match Maker.

Name: Quick Match
Description: A short one. No clock, one Star, a scratch opponent, nothing written to the season table.

Name: Cup Tie
Description: A full match that does not count towards the league. Unlocked with The Cup.

Name: Adventure
Description: A run into a biome. No clock, one Star, four tiers per encounter, and nothing is banked until you carry it home.

Name: First Match
Description: ROUND AN - YOUR FIRST MATCH. Plays while flag:tutorial_match is set (Progression.csv sets it on a new game and clears it at the final whistle). REPLACES: pressing Play a match (friendly) or starting a season, quick match or cup tie plays THIS instead. SQUAD: your side is data/IntroSquad.csv - Koch and eleven plain players with random names, no Stars, nobody has to be owned. Star Rotation yes swaps the other two of Koch's Tier in at the STAR PLAYER SWITCH. The prologue starts it on its own (Progression.csv kick_off_first_match, Do match:intro). ENEMY SQUAD (your note): the opposition is a squad CSV too - all plain players, no Stars, no brew. Opponent squad = take the side from that column.

Name: Second Match
Description: ROUND AN - YOUR SECOND MATCH, straight after the star-intro scene: the same first team (IntroSquad2.csv: same IDs as IntroSquad.csv = same players), Koch, and the three Bergmännlein Stars. Plays while flag:tutorial_match_2 is set (Progression.csv). Replaces the same buttons as intro. ENEMY SQUAD (your note): the opposition is a squad CSV too - plain players and three plain Stars that only give +1 to the next normal, non-elemental player. Opponent squad = take the side from that column.

Name: First Adventure
Description: ROUND AN - YOUR FIRST ADVENTURE (your note). While the Head Coach is sending you on your first run, the only team is your first team: data/IntroSquad2.csv (the same players as the second match, Koch and the three Bergmännlein Stars). No team to pick - pick a biome and a bounty on the board and you are off. Ends after one run carried home (count:adventures_home).

Name: Tutorial Match
Description: ROUND AN - THE TUTORIAL MATCH (Anthony, 7 Oct). Started by the Tutorial (the main menu button, or YES on a new save) straight after Pub Dialogue 1 - see tutorial.gd and Tuning.csv tutorial_first_scene / tutorial_match_mode. The Head Coach stops it again and again: every stop is a MatchTalk.csv row with Mode = tutorial. SQUAD: data/TutorialSquad.csv (Koch, a plain player and the Star, at Tier IV, and eleven plain players). FOUR CYCLES (8 Oct): Koch stays on as the Star for cycles 1-3 (TIME OUTs after 1 and 2, Do keep_star) and is swapped out at the switch after cycle 3. ENEMY SQUAD: all plain players. At full time the tutorial ends: the base (locked, Tuning.csv starting_team) or, from the main menu, the title screen. Nothing is written to the season table.

Name: The Brewer's Errand
Description: ROUND AN - THE TUTORIAL'S FIRST ADVENTURE ("the morning after", Anthony 8 Oct). While the morning is on, any Adventure plays as this: your party is data/TutorialAdventureSquad.csv, four Adventure Players, one per Tier. Koch stops the run at its firsts: the MatchTalk.csv rows with Mode tutorial_adventure (adventure_talk.gd). count:adventures_played goes up when any run ends (home, fled or fallen), which ends it.
